title: Past Simple mi, Present Perfect mi?
explain_tr: Türkçede ikisi de *"-dı"* ile çevrilebildiği için en çok karışan konulardan biri: *"Londra'ya gittim."*
**Past Simple**: geçmişte **belirli, bitmiş bir zaman** var (ya da biliniyor): *yesterday, last week, in 2019, two days ago, when I was a child*. → *I **went** to London **in 2019**.*

**Present Perfect**: zaman **belirtilmiyor** veya zaman dilimi **hâlâ devam ediyor**: *ever, never, already, yet, just, today, this week, so far*. → *I**'ve been** to London.* (hayatımda) / *I**'ve drunk** three coffees **today**.*
Genelde **önce Present Perfect ile konu açılır, sonra ayrıntı Past Simple ile verilir**: *Have you ever been to Izmir? – Yes, I have. I **went** there last summer. It **was** wonderful.*

Altın kural: **yesterday / ago / last … / in 2020 / When…?** ile **asla** Present Perfect kullanma: *I have seen him yesterday* ✗ → *I **saw** him yesterday* ✓. *When have you arrived?* ✗ → *When **did** you arrive?* ✓
explain_en: Past simple: finished time (yesterday, ago, last…, in 2019, when?). Present perfect: no specific time, experiences, unfinished time periods (today, this week), ever/never/already/yet/just.

pairs.wrong: I have seen this film last week.
pairs.right: I saw this film last week.

pairs.wrong: When have you moved to Istanbul?
pairs.right: When did you move to Istanbul?

Present Perfect + Past Simple ile iki cümle yaz:
(I / be / to Van) + (I / go / there / in 2022)
answer: I have been to Van. I went there in 2022.
I've been to Van. I went there in 2022.
